comment: Every item must be covered by a passing result, or carry a waiver, in at least one report attached to the release candidate. Section numbers refer to docs/SHIMMER3_TEST_PROCEDURE.md. Gates 1 and 2 are not listed: CI proves them on the tagged commit. The boot matrix row covers each radio firmware that shipped to customers.

items.title: Boot matrix: one unit per shipped radio firmware (RN42 v4.77, RN42 v6.15, RN4678 v1.00.5, RN4678 v1.23.0), banners recorded
Per-model behaviour walked on the models the change touches
Rest of gate 4 walked on at least one unit
Shipping host stack against the release candidate
A recording from the previous release still imports
Version skew walked in both directions
